notes:
REF-BM-02: Automatically fetches title and description and derives a favicon, but has no preview-image collection.
REF-BM-04: Editing exists, but note and description are conflated into one field rather than independently editable.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates a duplicate; there is no duplicate detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, domain, collection, and tags, but not a separate note or the complete URL path/query.
REF-BM-14: No #tag query syntax is parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal characters rather than exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no action targeting the whole currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-23: A field labelled Note can be written and displayed as plain text, but markdown is not rendered and it is conflated with description.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot preservation is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration is implemented.
REF-BM-29: Static collections are not reusable bundles of search and included/excluded tags.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import is implemented.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export is implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings interface or persistence for default sort, item count, or font size is implemented.
